title: Shot at a Mardi Gras ball
summary: A fight broke out at a ball; he took a stray bullet and was hospitalized before Paul's birth.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: We'll have to look that up, then. What about the Franz Ami? What about the Franz Ami? You played at the Franz Ami?
Yeah. On Robeson, between Samantha and Paula. That's where I got hired.
He got shot there. He got shot there. All right.

He had a Mardi Gras ball, you know. The Franz came there and they start arguing, you know. White fella just fell out of the rock and the other fella. I didn't know where they started shooting at one another.
And he was at the door, you see. He was picking up the money. He had the money in the restaurant.
Castor in the restaurant. And I got a stray bullet. There was three of us got... Wait.

The stomach. He stayed in the hospital. My mother was pregnant for him. He wasn't born yet. And he stayed in the hospital, I think my mother said 17 or 18 days. But they never defined the bullet. He still had that bullet. Paul wasn't born yet.
